原句：空间站平台扩大了科学实验范围，并提升了相关技术成果转化效率。

任务：先汉译英，再选出并列关系最清晰的一项。

back_content.text: The space station platform has expanded the scope of scientific experiments and improved the efficiency of transforming related technological achievements.
back_content.explanation: 本句强调“扩大范围 + 提升效率”的并列结果，需用平行动词结构呈现。

analysis_content.text:
① 识别信号：中文由“并”连接两个结果动作，属于并列推进而非主从。

② 核心规律：并列结果常用 has expanded ... and improved ...，保持主语、时态和语法槽位一致。

③ 验证：正确译文两端都描述平台带来的结果，语义平衡，没有把第二结果弱化为附属信息。
tips: 并列结果句优先做“动词对齐”检查。
如果两段都在回答“带来了什么”，就要同层表达。

The space station platform has expanded the scope of scientific experiments, which improved the efficiency of transforming related technological achievements.
The scope of scientific experiments has expanded and the efficiency has improved by the space station platform.
By expanding the scope of scientific experiments, the space station platform improved related technological achievements transformation efficiency and was expanded.

back_content.text: China's manufacturing sector has accelerated its digital transformation and also promoted the overall improvement of supply-chain coordination efficiency.
back_content.explanation: 并列句中两个谓语应对应两个同层级结果，避免一主一从。

③ 验证与纠偏：译文中两个谓语均与主语直接对应，避免了“效率提升”被误写为附属解释。
tips: 并列句优先保证信息同层级。
供应链协同效率可译为 supply-chain coordination efficiency。
